title: 有馬記念の後に・世紀末覇王、爆誕！

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ahh! The first sun of this new era shines bright. The world has been blessed with the birth of a champion.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And at long last, I now outshine that sun. Yes! I am the Royal Sun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Woooooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O claims a perfect victory!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: The curtain has fallen on the generational battle for supremacy that has raged since late last year! Welcome to a new era!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Well, Trainer? What have you to say in the presence of the Centurial Overlord?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: How do I come across in the eyes of the one who birthed the new ruler?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Is that so? Well, you must not forget your presence glows in the eyes of others too.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: We, you see, are twin suns—the strongest in all history.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now, will you lead me to my throne, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You are the only one left who can take my hand and not be rendered powerless by my majesty.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I reverently take her hand and guide her to the winner's circle.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Dear fans, the road has been long and arduous!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I declare here and now that, with this victory, I have become the Centurial Overlord!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The end of the century is upon us! My enemies are powerless before me. Powerless!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now, ladies and gentlemen, what is it that makes a king?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Many thoughts surely come to mind. However, only one condition is absolute.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And that is to never betray the faithful.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Heretofore, my running bespoke the Overlord, as so did my record.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And henceforth, as the Centurial Overlord, I vow to maintain a certain and flawless winning streak!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: All I ask in return is your faith and homage. I shall see to it your loyalty is repaid.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The lead I displayed today… can never be outdone! It proves I have surpassed the greatest generation.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Next year, the curtain will rise on a new season, in which I shall reign supreme!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Woooooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Everyone here feels something more than the difference in skill on display—what they feel is absolute strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O has shown the power to wrench the older generation from their position at the top.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Grrrr… She completely did us in.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: You okay with this, Grass? Where do we go from here?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I know… As a parting gift, this was far too painful.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I've spoken with Spe… Perhaps we should run in the Twinkle Series for the time being.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: A bird cannot take flight when filled with regret. We should forge a fresh stride, one which even the Centurial Overlord can't defeat.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now, it is time to conduct the founding ceremony for the new nation under my name.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: First, to introduce the members of the royal house.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The king is I! The queen is I! The prince is I! The princess… I!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And the princess's dearest pooch? I! So comprises the core of this royal family.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Next, the Centurial Overlord's closest and finest allies. The newly promoted Captain of Knights…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Is you, Meisho Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eeeek! M-m-me?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The one and only. You have proven your skills and fortitude. Henceforth, we shall run as partners.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yes, Opera O!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And taking up residence beside the castle, as to visit on occasion, is the daughter of House Ayabe…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'd… rather not. I mean, sounds like a meaningless role anyway.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Meaningless? Hardly! The royal family would not exist without House Ayabe.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Let us maintain the strong bonds we've forged, as neighbors!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …Really?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And now, the one most responsible for the dawning of my new era…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The one who led me to the throne… my trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yeaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I step onto the stage after Opera O's introduction.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Without our bond, Trainer, I would have never reached this glorious height.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Yes, our joint effort—it's what I aspired to create from the very beginning.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: If I, an Umamusume, and you, a human, can come together and seize victory…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: A beacon of harmony must emerge between our races! Bonds which cross borders are the strongest of all!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ladies and gentlemen! People of any and all races shall forever be equals in my kingdom… excluding me of course!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Join hands, work together, and prosper beneath the Centurial Overlord!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: One Earth, one family!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: We race together! This has always been my true goal as the Centurial Overlord!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O is victorious, and now her hidden ambition has come to light.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Waves of emotion course throughout the Nakayama Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: She doesn't fool me…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: No way it was her goal from the beginning. She came up with that spiel on the spot.
